blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in West End rose from 18 in June to 19 in October (+5.6%), and 7 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 12.6% of New Westminster’s 151 houses listed.

blocks.text: West End Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: New Westminster's zoning is Zoning Bylaw No. 6680, 2001, and its RS districts allow secondary suites, with laneway and carriage houses regulated under the same bylaw.

blocks.text: West End Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The City pairs the West End with Connaught Heights in its west-side planning, so City documents discuss the two together rather than as standalone neighbourhoods.
Twelfth Street is the commercial spine and eastern edge, and Sixth Avenue and Stewardson Way form the south edge, with the ground sloping to the Fraser River.
The nearest SkyTrain stations are the downtown New Westminster and Columbia stations on the Expo Line, east of the neighbourhood; there is no station inside the West End.

blocks.text: West End Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the Twelfth Street Heritage Inventory and the City's heritage register before planning exterior work on a Twelfth Street property.
Confirm the SD40 catchment for the exact address, since the city's single secondary school does not settle the elementary and middle assignments.

items.t: West End, New Westminster Homes for Sale

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in West End?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 19 houses listed in West End. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is West End a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in West End had a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in West End from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in West End over those 5 months, out of 75 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in West End?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Do West End streets have laneways?
faq.a: Many do: the City's Street Tree Master Plan records that the West End developed in the late 1800s and early 1900s and that many residential streets have rear laneways, and laneway and carriage houses are regulated under Zoning Bylaw No. 6680, 2001.

faq.q: Which secondary school serves the West End?
faq.a: 40's (SD40) only secondary school, serving the whole city; the recorded locator chain for 835 Eighth Street on the area's east side is Lord Kelvin Elementary, Fraser River Middle and New Westminster Secondary.
